fact: The 2024-2026 national open government action plan lists the creation of an open data portal among the government's initiatives since joining the OGP and, under commitment 6, speaks of the Côte d'Ivoire Open Data portal as running and to be enriched with datasets; it names no running body and does not tie the portal to an open data policy, and it gives no date for the portal, so the plan's publication date of 2025-01 is used.
system: portail Open Data de la Côte d'Ivoire

fact: The OGP/IRM page reports that the Government Information and Communication Centre (CICG) launched the open data portal data.gouv.ci under the 2016-2018 action plan, and that after training the Ministry in charge of Petroleum and Renewable Energies published around 50 new datasets on it by June 2020 (document dated 2020 as inferred; no earlier launch date given).

The Cote d'Ivoire government communications centre CICG runs the official open data portal, which lists 211 datasets across economy, society, education, energy and agriculture, the newest updated on 20 October 2026.

225.ci reports the CICG, which launched the data.gouv.ci portal in 2014, said it lets users consult, reuse and redistribute data on health, education, the economy and the environment, with a content update planned.
Digital Mag says the Open Data Cote d'Ivoire portal, started in 2014 by the CICG, was refreshed in 2024 and lists datasets such as 54 in economy, 24 in education and 22 in energy.

FAO says Cote d'Ivoire's agriculture ministry released the 2024-2025 annual agricultural survey results, with open data tables on the national Open Data portal and anonymised microdata in the national microdata catalogue.
system: Cote d'Ivoire national Open Data portal and NADA microdata catalogue

fact: ANStat's Open Data Portal coordinator reports that for the 2024/25 ODIN assessment the agency centralised its data categories as datasets on its Open Data Portal, downloadable in several formats such as Excel, PDF and PNG.
